data.one_liner: Battery-efficient native geofencing plugin for iOS and Android.
data.what_it_does: Allows your Flutter application to be alerted when the user enters, exits, or dwells in a geographical region. Handles events even when the app is in the background or terminated, and re-registers geofences after device reboot.
use_when: You need location-based triggers like entering or leaving an area
Geofencing must work when the app is terminated or in the background
You want battery-efficient native geofencing APIs on iOS and Android
avoid_when: You only need continuous real-time GPS tracking rather than boundary alerts
You are not willing to configure native permissions and iOS AppDelegate or Android Manifest settings
strengths: Works when application is in foreground, background, or terminated
Re-registers geofences automatically after device reboot on Android
Uses native iOS CLLocationManager and Android GeofencingClient APIs
weaknesses: Requires manual native configuration in AndroidManifest.xml and iOS AppDelegate/Info.plist
Does not handle requesting user permissions directly; requires a separate permission plugin
data.setup_notes: Requires adding location permissions, broadcast receivers, and foreground service definitions in AndroidManifest.xml, updating iOS Info.plist with location usage descriptions, and configuring the AppDelegate plugin registrant callback.
